prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 51.0 °C (64% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.6 °C (48% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 55.9 °C (55% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.68 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.47 s (2% above healthy). Hydraulic valve exhibits slight transient lag while maintaining target pressure.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.30 l/min (50% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 797 W·min/l (108% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 30.6 % (48% below healthy). Significant reduction in delivered volume flow at nominal electrical power indicates severe internal pump slippage.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 56.8 bar (22% above healthy). Slight increase in pressure oscillations indicates reduced surge dampening capacity.
